title: First piano player and house parties
summary: His first piano player was Little Willie; they played house parties, which he recalls as better days with the district open.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: What was the name of that first piano player you worked with when you were just getting started?
Oh, he's that Little Willie they called him.
Did he have any other name, that Little Willie?

His first name? I don't know his first name. I don't know why I know I have to see his parents, his sister or somebody. They called him Little Willie. And they had another boy, he's in California now, Little Red. They did play the piano by ear, see. We used to go around and play house parties, see. Oh, those days were better days than now.
Because they had no nightclubs in different schools. They didn't house part like that and red light district was open and all that. It was fine.
